description: This file defines the 'Event' class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing event registration, triggering, unregistering, and clearing event handlers within the system.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Handles event registration, triggering, unregistration, and clearing within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Event class with a Registry object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event with a trigger, associated action, and optional priority.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers all actions associated with a specific event name.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a specific event trigger-action association based on trigger and route.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all actions associated with a specific trigger.
